parsed.explanation: Combined operative regime is national-border/federal plus state layer. Federal passport/visa sex-marker policy creates documented traveller-facing friction: mismatched documents, X-marker denial, refusals, possible permanent fraud finding, confiscation. National single-sex facility ban applies regardless of local protections. Immigration custody harm is severe if encountered. State/provincial low-risk for adults and local ordinances mitigate employment/housing but do not offset federal screening/facilities. Adult-with-minor travel is materially worse due to minor care, school reporting, sports and document restrictions. Street violence not documented, but absence is not safety; gay/trans panic and missing state hate crime leave gaps.

entry_documents.exposure: New passports require M/F per birth documents; X stopped; discrepancy/reasonable doubt triggers secondary checks, refusal, requests, confiscation/block, possible permanent fraud if wilful misrepresentation material.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid until expiry; courts/legal-aid FAQ; no trans-specific criminal statute.
entry_documents.interaction: Federal screening overrides state/municipal anti-discrimination; mismatch can turn entry delay into refusal or immigration examination.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Immigration custody reports forced labour, beatings, solitary, sexual abuse; entry refusal/fraud could escalate to detention. Corrections conversion policies show hostile custody practice.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented for traveller custody; formal legal process and courts exist but effectiveness uncertain.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Document mismatch can become investigation; custody exposure dominates paper protections.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: National order bars government-funded single-sex facilities congruent with identity; federal buildings apply; some states ban including private; arrest example under state trespass.
federal_state_facilities.protection: State has no mapped bathroom ban; governor vetoed bills; municipal ordinances; federal employment/hate-crime protections.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: State/local protections do not cancel federal facility rule; enforcement depends on venue.

care_services.exposure: Adult continuity care uncertain; minor restrictions are severe: surgery ban, Medicaid exclusion, school hotline, funding freeze, criminalising social transition; public insurance bar proposed.
care_services.protection: State employee coverage order; emergency care? not documented; clinics may function.
care_services.interaction: Care-seeking by minor/guardian can trigger outing and investigation.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National EO frames gender ideology hostile; counterterrorism mentions radically pro-transgender; rewards; 66% support binary documents; state panic defence and no state GI hate crime.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: No trans-specific crime; national hate-crime and Title VII; DOJ/state EO/municipal protections; courts contest orders.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Hostile federal policy plus local protections creates patchwork enforcement.

minors_guardians.exposure: Trans minor faces barred female sports, care refusal, school reporting, document mismatch, risk of forced outing to guardians/staff; guardians may be pressured/prosecuted for facilitating care.
minors_guardians.protection: Not documented for visitor minors; resident birth-cert order unrelated.
minors_guardians.interaction: Guardian care request can become investigation; family travel increases scrutiny.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No division-specific trans-directed violence documented; state hate statute lacks GI; panic defence may reduce culpability; traveler identifiable stranger.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime GI, municipal ordinances, police enforce laws; advocacy guides.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Absence is not safety; federal hostility may embolden some, local protections may deter.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Unresolved litigation, changing orders, inconsistent ports/venues, private databases, officer discretion, unclear minor care interactions.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Legal-aid FAQ, courts, complaint mechanisms, advocacy guides, some enforcement.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies may be slow and require outing; no effective remedy for permanent fraud.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar secondary screening/administrative refusal, but dossier adds federal facility bans, passport confiscation, immigration custody abuse and minor criminalisation; lower.
Closest: universal document/sex-marker exposure and administrative refusal. Slightly lower because custody harm and minor-care restrictions are severe; local protections prevent descent into 0.35.
No mandatory gender examination/registry blocking transit, but federal entry/facility/care hostility and possible custody keep this above pure bureaucratic gender exams.

parsed.synthesis: Adult alone faces high but not catastrophic risk: federal passport/visa mismatch can lead to secondary screening, refusal, stranding, or possible fraud; federal facility bans can exclude, while local employment/housing protections help. Custody abuse is documented but conditional. Adult with minor faces materially higher risk: care, school, sports and documents can force outing and investigation. Remedies exist but are patchwork, slow, and may themselves require disclosure.
